454    /**
455     * CalculateStatus
456     *
457     * Calculates the status of the Recurring Invoice.
458     *
459     * We only apply the pending status on new models, we never revert an invoice back to
460     * pending.
461     * @param  bool $new_model
462     * @return int
463     */
464    public function calculateStatus(bool $new_model = false) //15-02-2024 - $new_model needed
465    {
466
467        if ($this->remaining_cycles == 0) {
468            return self::STATUS_COMPLETED;
469        } elseif ($new_model && $this->status_id == self::STATUS_ACTIVE && Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date)->isFuture()) {
470            return self::STATUS_PENDING;
471        } elseif ($this->remaining_cycles != 0 && ($this->status_id == self::STATUS_COMPLETED)) {
472            return self::STATUS_ACTIVE;
473        }
474
475        return $this->status_id;
476
477    }

479    public function nextSendDate(): ?Carbon
480    {
481        if (! $this->next_send_date_client) {
482            return null;
483        }
484
485        $offset = $this->client->timezone_offset();
486
487        /* If this setting is enabled, the recurring invoice may be set in the past */
488
489        if ($this->company->stop_on_unpaid_recurring) {
490            /* Lets set the next send date to now so we increment from today, rather than in the past*/
491            if (Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date)->lt(now()->subDays(3))) {
492                $this->next_send_date_client = now()->format('Y-m-d');
493            }
494        }
495
496        switch ($this->frequency_id) {
497            case self::FREQUENCY_DAILY:
498                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addDay()->addSeconds($offset);
499            case self::FREQUENCY_WEEKLY:
500                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addWeek()->addSeconds($offset);
501            case self::FREQUENCY_TWO_WEEKS:
502                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addWeeks(2)->addSeconds($offset);
503            case self::FREQUENCY_FOUR_WEEKS:
504                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addWeeks(4)->addSeconds($offset);
505            case self::FREQUENCY_MONTHLY:
506                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addMonthNoOverflow()->addSeconds($offset);
507            case self::FREQUENCY_TWO_MONTHS:
508                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addMonthsNoOverflow(2)->addSeconds($offset);
509            case self::FREQUENCY_THREE_MONTHS:
510                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addMonthsNoOverflow(3)->addSeconds($offset);
511            case self::FREQUENCY_FOUR_MONTHS:
512                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addMonthsNoOverflow(4)->addSeconds($offset);
513            case self::FREQUENCY_SIX_MONTHS:
514                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addMonthsNoOverflow(6)->addSeconds($offset);
515            case self::FREQUENCY_ANNUALLY:
516                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addYear()->addSeconds($offset);
517            case self::FREQUENCY_TWO_YEARS:
518                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addYears(2)->addSeconds($offset);
519            case self::FREQUENCY_THREE_YEARS:
520                return Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->addYears(3)->addSeconds($offset);
521            default:
522                return null;
523        }
524    }

728    /**
729     * Access the invoice calculator object.
730     *
731     * @return InvoiceSumInclusive | InvoiceSum The invoice calculator object getters
732     */
733    public function calc(): InvoiceSumInclusive | InvoiceSum
734    {
735        $invoice_calc = null;
736
737        if ($this->uses_inclusive_taxes) {
738            $invoice_calc = new InvoiceSumInclusive($this);
739        } else {
740            $invoice_calc = new InvoiceSum($this);
741        }
742
743        return $invoice_calc->build();
744    }
745
746    /*
747     * Important to note when playing with carbon dates - in order
748     * not to modify the original instance, always use a `->copy()`
749     *
750     */
751    public function recurringDates()
752    {
753        /* Return early if nothing to send back! */
754        if ($this->status_id == self::STATUS_COMPLETED ||
755            $this->remaining_cycles == 0 ||
756            ! $this->next_send_date) {
757            return [];
758        }
759
760        /* Endless - lets send 10 back*/
761        $iterations = $this->remaining_cycles;
762
763        if ($this->remaining_cycles == -1) {
764            $iterations = 10;
765        }
766
767        $data = [];
768
769        if (! Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)) {
770            return $data;
771        }
772
773        $next_send_date = Carbon::parse($this->next_send_date_client)->startOfDay()->copy();
774
775        for ($x = 0; $x < $iterations; $x++) {
776            // we don't add the days... we calc the day of the month!!
777            $next_due_date = $this->calculateDueDate($next_send_date->copy()->format('Y-m-d'));
778            $next_due_date_string = $next_due_date ? $next_due_date->format('Y-m-d') : '';
779
780            // $next_send_date = Carbon::parse($next_send_date);
781
782            $data[] = [
783                'send_date' => $next_send_date->format('Y-m-d'),
784                'due_date' => $next_due_date_string,
785            ];
786
787            // /* Fixes the timeshift in case the offset is negative which cause a infinite loop due to UTC +0*/
788            // if ($this->client->timezone_offset() < 0) {
789            //     $next_send_date = $this->nextSendDateClient($next_send_date->addDay()->format('Y-m-d'));
790            // } else {
791            $next_send_date = $this->nextDateByFrequencyNoOffset($next_send_date);
792            // }
793        }
794
795        return $data;
796    }

798    public function calculateDueDate($date)
799    {
800        switch ($this->due_date_days) {
801            case 'terms':
802            case '':
803            case '0':
804                return $this->calculateDateFromTerms($date);
805
806            case 'on_receipt':
807                return Carbon::parse($date)->copy();
808
809            default:
810
811                // 2025-01-23 - Reverting this back, this is tightly linked to recurring invoice generation and
812                // the timezone offset of the client AND when it was generated.
813                $date = Carbon::parse($date);
814                // $date = now()->addSeconds($this->client->timezone_offset());
815                //$date = Carbon::parse($date)->addSeconds($this->client->timezone_offset());
816                return $this->setDayOfMonth($date, $this->due_date_days);
817        }
818    }

820    /**
821     * Calculates a date based on the client payment terms.
822     *
823     * @param  Carbon $date A given date
824     * @return null|Carbon  The date
825     */
826    public function calculateDateFromTerms($date)
827    {
828        $new_date = Carbon::parse($date);
829
830        $client_payment_terms = $this->client->getSetting('payment_terms');
